2 components on the public surface of `@theproductiveschedule/horizon-design-system`, each with a page that says when to use it, how to call it, what it was built from, and what has changed.

| Component | Status | Since | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Button](/core/components/button/) | released | 0.1.0 | Buttons prompt most actions in a UI. |
| [Card](/core/components/card/) | released | 0.1.0 | Use this card component to display content in visually aesthetics, clean and interactive way. |

## What is not here

Every component on the registry has cleared its release review. Anything in design or build appears on the [Roadmap](/get-started/roadmap/) until it does.

Internal subcomponents — `cardLayout`, `cardImage`, `iconContainer`, `cardText` — are documented inside the component that uses them, not as pages of their own, because they are not exported.
